title: Nonconvex Carnot Limit Shapes for Branching Random Walks on the Heisenberg Group
summary: We study a supercritical branching random walk on the discrete Heisenberg group driven by the four standard horizontal generators. Horizontal position has scale $n$, whereas the central coordinate records discrete area and has scale $n^2$. On the Galton-Watson survival event, we prove almost sure Hausdorff convergence, under Carnot scaling, of both the rescaled particle positions and the collections of enhanced ancestral paths.
